text.es: Marta: Me duele que otra persona vea tu sonrisa de enamorada, que pueda coger tu mano caliente en el bolsillo de un abrigo, que quieras alargar las noches con otra persona para que no llegue el amanecer. Que imagines un futuro con alguien que no soy yo. Porque siempre pensé que yo era única para ti. Marta: No puedo soportar pensar que sientes por alguien lo mismo que has sentido por mí. Fina: Nunca ha habido, ni habrá nadie en mi vida como tú. Fina: Es tu mano la que quiero que agarre la mía dentro del bolsillo del abrigo. Y es contigo y solo contigo, con quien yo me imagino mi futuro y con quien quiero pasar el resto de noches de mi vida.
text.en: Marta: It hurts me that someone else sees the smile of a woman in love on your face, that someone else can hold your warm hand in a coat pocket, that you'd want to make the nights longer with someone else so that dawn never comes. That you'd imagine a future with someone who isn't me. Because I always thought I was the only one for you. Marta: I can't bear to think that you feel for someone else the same thing you've felt for me. Fina: There has never been, nor will there ever be, anyone in my life like you. Fina: It's your hand that I want to hold mine inside the coat pocket. And it's with you and only you that I imagine my future, and with whom I want to spend the rest of the nights of my life.
